partner_json_extract.hero: Ola x Navier - India's electric-mobility pioneer, on the water
partner_json_extract.why_now: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, ~10x more efficient per passenger-mile, smooth and near-silent, hybrid-capable and autonomy-ready - and all-electric on the Pioneer II, a direct fit for Ola Electric's brand. A ~100-vessel network is ramping in the Maldives next door; Kochi's electric Water Metro proves India's clean-ferry appetite; and India's busiest coastal flows run on diesel craft. The clean-water category gets claimed cluster-by-cluster.
partner_json_extract.network_thesis: One app. India's 7,500 km coastline. The clean-water layer of India's electric-mobility pioneer. | India is a coastline of harbours, tidal rivers, backwaters and island archipelagos - and no platform owns the water. Ola Electric gives Ola a clean-mobility identity that fits the water perfectly: the same all-electric foiling tier proven in the Maldives extends to Mumbai's harbour, Goa's coast, Kerala's backwaters, the Andaman islands, Kolkata's Hooghly waterfront and the Chennai/ECR coast. Pick one market to prove it, or roll the recommended sequence. The fleet, app integration and captain-partner model are identical everywhere.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Ola already runs real-time demand, dispatch, pricing and a vast driver-partner network across India. An electric foiling water tier slots straight in: same app, captain-partners on the water, the water leg booked door-to-door with the Ola ride to and from the jetty - and a clean story consistent end-to-end with Ola Electric.
partner_json_extract.differentiation: {'why_navier': 'All-electric (Pioneer II) and software-defined - a direct fit for the Ola Electric identity - with a factory in Turkey for supply and a ~100-vessel network already proving the model in the Maldives. The clean water tier is a category Ola can own.'}
partner_json_extract.the_ask: {'navier_brings': 'The software-defined, all-electric foiling fleet (Pioneer II + Quanta-LR), captain training, maintenance and the network operating system.', 'partner_brings': 'Demand and dispatch through the Ola app, the wallet, the clean-mobility brand, and the choice of launch city.', 'next_step': 'Scope a first pilot in one flagship cluster — Mumbai or Kochi — co-defining the in-app electric water tier on three corridors.'}
partner_json_extract.close: India's electric-mobility pioneer — now on the water. | Ola made India's roads electric. Water is the next clean surface, and no road rival can follow there on price. Start in one harbour or backwater, prove the electric foiling tier, and extend it across India's coast.
